messages:
Megan (SalesOps): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — two asks: 1) clarification on Q2 pipeline targets vs FY expectations, and 2) partner enablement cadence + incentives. can leadership confirm?
Aisha (CEO): short answer — Q2 plan: conservative $3.5M ARR, stretch $5M ARR. FY guidance unchanged. partners: we want a repeatable enablement playbook; target deliverable EOM.
Priya (Head GTM): to add context — product roadmap items (routing policies + partner telemetry) land next two weeks which should unblock several enterprise opportunities. will share impacts doc.
Marco (VP Sales): can we get a concrete commitment on partner co-sell credits / referral bonusing? our SDRs are asking for the mechanics so they can prioritize partner-led motions.
Jules (Partnerships): noted. legal is reviewing an MSA addendum for referral credits. rough ETA: 10 business days. also working on a partner play template for onboarding (slides + one-pager).
Evan (Product): FYI routing policies will be behind a feature flag initially. if sales wants early access, we can run a small beta. Marco — can you share top 5 target deals that would benefit?
Marco (VP Sales): yes. sending list in a sec. main ones: Acme Health, ClearBank, NovaAI, BrightRetail, DataFold.
Sam (Ops): I'll spin up a shared doc and invite the beta list. link: https://redwood.internal/ops/beta-routing (internal)
Megan (SalesOps): thanks. for pipeline clarity — is the $3.5M Q2 number net of churn, or net new only? need to set expectations for forecast calls.
Aisha (CEO): $3.5M is net new ARR bookings target for Q2. churn assumed at current baseline. use that for forecasting.
Priya (Head GTM): on enablement cadence, proposal: weekly 30-min partner office hours + a central playbook + a monthly co-sell sync. Thoughts? :thumbsup: / :thinking_face:
Jules (Partnerships): that cadence works for me. can we add a quarterly joint-review with sales leadership to measure partner-sourced pipeline?
Marco (VP Sales): yes please. quarterly review + SLAs on lead response time (48h) would help.
Evan (Product): for the beta group I'll need a brief one-pager from sales with acceptance criteria (business metrics we’ll measure). sample KPI snippet: ```
- target_pipeline_added: $1.2M
- demo_to_deal_ratio: 18%
- avg_time_to_close: 42 days
```
Megan (SalesOps): I'll draft the one-pager template and circulate today.
Aisha (CEO): let's capture follow-ups: 1) Jules/legal — MSA addendum ETA 10bd, 2) Evan — feature flag beta plan + acceptance criteria, 3) Priya/Jules — enablement playbook by EOM, 4) Marco/Megan — share top deals + one-pager. we'll reconvene Tue 10am PT to finalize.
Megan (SalesOps): proposing Tue 10am PT for the follow-up — calendar invite pls.
Aisha (CEO): works for me. @Jules @Evan please bring drafts.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: All-Hands Follow-up — Sales & Partnerships (Tue 10:00 AM PT). Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Priya, Jules, Evan, Megan, Sam.
Megan (SalesOps): thanks all — I'll convert these notes into an action tracker and share after the meeting. :raised_hands:
